we focus on benchmarks currently used to evaluate LLMs because these models reveal inconsistencies and weaknesses in standardized benchmarks that were created earlier. Since benchmarks vary in format and modality, we focus here on text-based benchmarks: text as input, and text as output. These benchmarks can come in many shapes, such as classification, summarization, generation, and so on.
a benchmark is a dataset (or an ensemble of datasets) associated with one or multiple metrics, and a way to aggregate system performances
